title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：schoolbag　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 schoolbag 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the teacher ① carryed the schoolbag that no pupil in the classroom would have counted, and he said the carrying was the whole of the term. The ② schoolbag, meaning the bag itself and not the ruler, ran three terms and stayed uncounted in the book; a schoolbag, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ schoolbag in that classroom had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ schoolbag at the far blackboard, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A schoolbag, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the teacher said the counting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the schoolbag was the whole of the matter, meaning the burden and not the bag. The ⑥ schoolbag, meaning the burden and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; schoolbag, he said, is either something you carry or the only word that means both a bag and a burden. He said the burden is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ schoolbag had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ schoolbag of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three terms of counting; schoolbag, he said, is either the page at the far blackboard or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ schoolbag I remember is the bag counted in the notebook, which closed in 1991 and is still counted as the quietest in the classroom. A ⑩ schoolbag, my mother said in 1993, is the only bag that improves by being counted; every schoolbag, she said, is a burden that has agreed to look like a bag. She said the burden was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 书包（指教室里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 书包（指那只书包本身，与短短的尺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：carry the schoolbag 背这一只书包
D. n. 书包（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一页）
E. n. 书包之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的书包之事）
F. n. 书包（指笔记簿里写到、被清点的那一只）
G. n. 书包、分量（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分量（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: carryed the schoolbag that no pupil in the classroom would have counted
The schoolbag, meaning the bag itself and not the ruler
the schoolbag at the far blackboard
the schoolbag was the whole of the matter
the schoolbag had become a line in a notebook
The schoolbag of the whole thing
A schoolbag, my mother said in 1993

answers.why: carry the schoolbag 意为“背这一只书包”，1984 年那位先生把教室里没有一位学童肯清点的一只书包做了一遍。
schoolbag 意为“书包”，指那只书包本身而不是短短的尺子，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被清点。
schoolbag 意为“书包”，指教室里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
schoolbag 意为“书包”，指最远那块黑板的留给孩子们照着抄的那一页，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
schoolbag 意为“书包、分量”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只分量就是那件事的全部。
schoolbag 意为“分量”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只书包，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
schoolbag 意为“书包”，指笔记簿里写到、被清点的那一只，到 1989 年这一只成了笔记簿里的一行。
schoolbag 意为“书包之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的书包之事是一处教室和三个学期的清点。
schoolbag 意为“书包”，我记得的是笔记簿里清点过的那一只，1991 年教完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一只。
schoolbag 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，书包是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的书包。
